statement: You are given an integer array nums.
A subarray is a non-empty run of adjacent elements. Return the largest product of the elements of any subarray.
A negative number can turn the smallest product into the largest one, and a zero resets any product that includes it.

examples.explanation: [2, 3] has product 6. Including the -2 makes the product negative, and [4] on its own is smaller.
The two negatives in [-3, -10] multiply to 30, which beats [6, 2] = 12 and the negative product of all three negatives.

constraints: The product of any subarray fits in a 32-bit integer
